S09 E20 — If You Loved Me
Kaleb tries to convince Jazmine that if she loved him she would have sex with him; Jazmine tells Kaleb that she isn't ready; Ella and Curtis return from their vacation early.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S13 E07 — I Wanna Dance With Somebody
When Calvin Jr.'s mom can't take him to the mother-son dance, Miranda and Laura compete to be her replacement.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S09 E09 — Someone
Miranda's interested in giving Calvin a second chance; after his divorce, Calvin decides to date again; Miranda and Calvin's new woman know each other.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S12 E12 — I Am Handy Woman, Hear Me Roar
An argument between Malik and Lisa trickles down to C.J. and Janine; Ella chooses technology over a traditional handyman for home repairs.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S11 E07 — Payne-Ting
When Calvin, CJ, and Malik clean out Curtis and Ella's garage, they stumble upon Ella's secret diary filled with love poems she wrote to another man; thinking Ella is cheating on Curtis, they all start questioning their own relationship.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S13 E08 — A Payneful Father's Day
Ella organizes the women to plan a special Father's Day for the men in their lives; Floyd and Glo have their first argument as a couple.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S11 E02 — Major Payne
Lisa struggles with what classes to take in college and is afraid she may make the wrong choices.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S08 E63 — Right Turn
Curtis does community service at the Help Center; Miranda doesn't invite Janine to a concert.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S12 E05 — Forget Me Not
Curtis is involved in an accident that alters his personality; C.J. takes over the twins' school project and strives for excellence.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S10 E11 — Bearer of Bad News
Calvin wants his son in his wedding, but Miranda might not be on board.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S12 E01 — Like New Money
Curtis suspects his food truck was blown up intentionally, and he starts investigating the incident; Calvin must get to the bottom of Calvin Jr.'s mischievous deeds.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S10 E21 — The First Day
While Calvin and Laura make wedding plans, Miranda has made plans of her own.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S12 E08 — Paynes in the Butt
Ella decides to go against the grain and use technology instead of paying someone to do repairs; Malik and Lisa's argument causes discord between C.J. and Janine.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S08 E46 — In Payne
Calvin confesses to Ella that he thinks he would have been better off dead, so Curtis has a heart-to-heart with Calvin.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S10 E19 — A Payneful Compromise
Following Curtis' medical checkup, Ella wants Curtis to improve his diet, prompting the Payne family to learn an important lesson in compromising.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S10 E14 — DNAin't
Curtis has selfish motives for wanting the family to take a DNA test; it all backfires when he finds out about his heritage and when they discover Ella's family line.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S10 E17 — Wondering Prince
Lisa helps Miranda set up her online dating profile.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S13 E14 — House of Funk
Calvin and Laura try to teach the boys to clean up after themselves; Ella meets with the head deacon to discuss a tense situation, but she does not get the response she expected when she brings up some serious concerns.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S09 E12 — Lucky Cards
Curtis revisits old habits; Laura and Calvin explore their new romance.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S12 E13 — Make It Rain
Calvin attempts to plan a bachelor party against Laura's will; Malik struggles with putting together a toy for his daughter.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S11 E18 — Hashtag Help
Curtis wants to build his Sauce Boss brand and Ella needs to get women to register for the church's help center to receive a much-needed grant.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S08 E50 — Scars of Payne
Ella runs a gun buy-back program at the Help Center; Curtis wants to volunteer at the Help Center.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S10 E07 — In the Hot Seat
Calvin and Laura put their engagement to the test, joining pre-marital counseling.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S12 E15 — Out In the Open
The unfortunate news about a young firefighter forces C.J. to have a transparent conversation with Malik and Jazmine; Miranda discovers she's missing more than just the companionship of a man.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S12 E21 — Double Trouble
To Curtis' horror, Floyd and Glo begin dating and want to double-date with him and Ella; Pookie and Peanut ask CJ to mentor them when they decide to become firefighters.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S08 E81 — The Call Back
Curtis must deal with resentment after he is called back to work.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S13 E16 — Paynefully Moving On
Ella has become conflicted with the politics of her church and has to make a big decision; Floyd worries that his past behavior might get him canceled and hurt his business.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S11 E21 — So Nice to Meat You
After Glo exchanges harsh words with Curtis she gives him 210lbs of pork that a butcher-friend gave her; Curtis is suspicious of the gesture and begins piecing together an unlikely tale of matricide and cannibalism.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S09 E19 — The Package
Kaleb is putting extreme pressure on Jazmine to have sex with him for her first time, but Calvin comes in and rains on their parade.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S08 E65 — Payneful Divorce
Malik and Summer have their marriage annulled; Miranda temps at the office when Janine needs an assistant.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S12 E14 — Say My Name
Calvin feels some type of way when Miranda gets swept off her feet, causing him to make an epic mistake; a chain letter changes C.J. and Ella's fortune.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S07 E41 — House Guest
Ella helps a victim of domestic abuse; Jazmine and C.J. prepare for the father-daughter dance.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S08 E68 — Payneful Pop In
Curtis and Ella keep popping in unannounced to CJ and Janine's; Jazmine is accused of cheating on an exam, but she's covering for a friend.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S10 E04 — Back That Thang Up
C.J.'s recurring back problem forces him to face an even bigger issue.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S09 E18 — Out of Character
Ella claims she didn't smoke, although her lipstick was found on the vape pen.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S11 E12 — Going to the Chapel and Not Getting Married
When Ella learns Curtis went behind her back and put Miranda on a $500 budget to plan their wedding renewal, she debates whether she should marry Curtis all over again.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S09 E01 — A Wise Man's Opinion
Malik is hesitant to give the news to his family about Lisa's pregnancy.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S13 E03 — No Bueno
Jazmine reminds a forgetful C.J. about his first wedding anniversary; Curtis and Ella bring over a cake called No Bueno to celebrate, only to learn there is no celebration to be had; Calvin prepares to attend Pookie's wedding solo.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S08 E82 — All's Well
Calvin and C.J. plan an anniversary celebration for Miranda and Janine.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S09 E17 — Dark Thirty
After taking a hit from a vape pen, Curtis seems to think he is now an addict.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S11 E13 — Unwelcomed Neighbors
It looks like someone is occupying the old Caskey house; Curtis enlists C.J. to help him investigate it; when Curtis alerts C.J., Lisa overhears and adds fuel to the fire, stating she saw some suspicious activity happen outside that house.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S12 E17 — El Capitan
Curtis becomes the neighborhood watch Captain and the power goes to his head, much to the demise of the family; Jazmine tries to convince CJ and Malik that they can enjoy the games with healthy food.

title: Tyler Perry's House of Payne
description:
S09 E08 — From Heart to Heart
Miranda takes Calvin to court for more child support; CJ has had it with Lisa; Calvin and Miranda have mixed feelings about their divorce.
